title: EntityRollupDescriptor
description: Defines a virtual rollup property that aggregates records of another entity whose foreign key points back to the owning record.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use rollups for counts and sums over child/related records, for example the number of orders per customer or the total amount of order lines per order. `sourceEntityName` is the entity being aggregated and `foreignKeyPropertyName` is the FK property on that entity that references the owning entity. `count` needs no `valuePropertyName`; `sum`, `average`, `min`, and `max` require a numeric/date `valuePropertyName` on the source entity. Rollup properties are read-only and never stored: the runtime forces `isMappedToDbField: false`, `allowSetByClients: false`, and clears required/unique/default settings. Rollups cannot be combined with `foreignKey`, `formula`, or `collection`.

sourceEntityName.description: Full name of the entity whose records are aggregated, for example 'Acme.Orders.Order'.

foreignKeyPropertyName.description: Foreign key property on sourceEntityName that references the owning entity, for example 'CustomerId'.

valuePropertyName.description: Property on sourceEntityName to aggregate. Required for sum, average, min, and max; omit for count.

operation.description: Aggregation operation. Prefer lower-case values; PascalCase aliases are accepted.
